name: decline-grant-recommendation
description: Decline a pending grant recommendation. Permanently marks it as declined — Curia will never surface this specific recommendation again (anti-nag). Use when the principal says no to a suggested grant ('no', 'not Dana', 'don't recommend that again'). recommendation_id must be the UUID from the recommendation. The id is in the recommendation's task (task-list tag grant-recommendation): the part of its grant-rec:<uuid> tag after the colon. Once this succeeds, task-complete that task with the outcome; if it fails, leave the task open.

inputs.recommendation_id: string (UUID of the pending grant recommendation)

outputs.already_resolved: boolean? (true when it was already declined: nothing changed; close its task)
